name: Shirasato Kaede
source:
[b]Tsuntsun (Self-Proclaimed) Shrine Maiden[/b]

Takumi's senior who is one year older than him. The captain of the school swim team. She's also works as a shrine maiden.

She is dignified and the very definition of perfection. Teachers and her classmates greatly trust her.

She is naive and has strong opinions about certain things. Due to a past experience, she quite cold towards Takumi.
